lines.text: We burned the midnight oil last night.

data.define: To keep working late into the night.

example.text: We burned the midnight oil last night.

misuse.text: Don't say it about lighting candles.

data.l1_hook: अभी भी दो बजे रात को "burn the midnight oil" कर रहे हो?
data.l1_ex: हमने कल रात "burn the midnight oil" किया।

native.tip: “burn the midnight oil” = देर रात तक मेहनत करना. उदाहरण: “We burned the midnight oil last night.”
